messages.subject: For Andreas Wulff | Public Affairs, Sustainability & Responsible Growth | Executive Proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Wulff,

I am writing from Guyana, where I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work sits at the intersection of government relations, regulatory coordination, ESG, stakeholder strategy and executive issue management in a major resource operation.

Vår Energi's Public Affairs and sustainability agenda is a strong fit with the problems I solve today: converting external expectations into internal ownership, maintaining disciplined relationships with public institutions, surfacing stakeholder risk early and ensuring commitments are supported by evidence and follow-through.

I prepared a Vår Energi-specific Strategic Value Creation Proposal rather than sending a conventional CV alone. It sets out where I would add value across public affairs, commitment governance, ESG evidence and country-facing reputation intelligence. My three-page Executive CV forms the final section.

I am open to relocation to Norway and employer-supported work authorization. My strongest fit would be a Director, Head or senior leadership mandate in Public Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, External Affairs, Strategic Partnerships or country-facing stakeholder leadership.

I would value a short confidential conversation. If another executive owns the most relevant mandate, I would also be grateful if you would route the proposal internally.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposal: Public Affairs, Sustainability and Responsible Growth on the Norwegian Continental Shelf
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Vår Energi's growth agenda depends on more than production performance. Public legitimacy, regulatory confidence, stakeholder alignment, sustainability evidence and disciplined external engagement all shape the company's ability to grow responsibly on the Norwegian Continental Shelf. I bring director-level experience leading government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive coordination inside a major multinational resource operation. My strongest contribution would be to connect public affairs and sustainability to operating decisions, ensuring external commitments have clear owners, evidence and follow-through while helping leadership anticipate institutional and stakeholder issues before they become execution constraints.
strategic_brief.company_context: Vår Energi positions itself as a leading independent producer on the Norwegian Continental Shelf with ambitions around safe operations, responsible value creation, low emissions and strong ESG performance. The company is simultaneously managing growth, complex project portfolios, public expectations and an evolving energy-policy environment. Its executive structure includes dedicated Public Affairs and Safety & Sustainability leadership, which signals that institutional trust and non-financial performance are central to the business model. The opportunity is to make those disciplines even more operational: stronger stakeholder intelligence, clearer commitment governance, faster escalation of emerging issues and tighter linkage between public positioning, sustainability evidence and project execution.

opportunities.title: Public affairs tied to project outcomes
opportunities.rationale: Public-affairs teams create the most value when institutional engagement is connected to concrete project, permitting, operating and reputation priorities. Without a disciplined issue architecture, important signals can be fragmented across functions and surfaced too late.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would build an executive issue and stakeholder framework linking ministries, regulators, local authorities and industry actors to specific business decisions, owners, milestones and escalation paths.

opportunities.title: Stakeholder commitment governance
opportunities.rationale: Large energy operations accumulate commitments across regulators, communities, partners and public institutions. Execution risk rises when commitments are not translated into accountable internal actions, evidence requirements and closure records.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would establish a practical commitments register and cross-functional review rhythm that connects external promises to accountable owners, due dates, evidence and executive visibility.

opportunities.title: ESG evidence and assurance readiness
opportunities.rationale: Vår Energi's stated ESG ambitions depend on credible evidence behind climate, safety, sustainability and stakeholder claims. Strong data ownership and source traceability support both management confidence and external credibility.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would strengthen source ownership, evidence trails and review readiness, drawing on carbon-data and renewable-energy governance work built from physical operating records in a regulated industrial environment.

opportunities.title: Country-facing reputation intelligence
opportunities.rationale: Reputation risk often develops through local signals before it reaches formal corporate reporting. A disciplined mechanism for capturing stakeholder concerns, regulatory shifts and emerging issues improves response quality and protects leadership from surprises.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would create a concise country-facing intelligence process that ranks issues by materiality, identifies response owners and connects external developments to leadership decisions and communication strategy.

days_0_30: Map the highest-value public affairs, sustainability and stakeholder interfaces.
Review material commitments and identify evidence or ownership gaps.
days_31_60: Introduce an executive issue register and stakeholder engagement map.
Align selected sustainability narratives with source evidence and operating owners.
days_61_90: Advance priority institutional workstreams to measurable outcomes.
Deliver a dashboard covering commitments, stakeholder exposure, evidence status and management action.
days_91_180: Embed the operating rhythm across selected assets or functions.
Use live issues to refine escalation, engagement and assurance standards.

potential_impact: Earlier visibility of material regulatory and stakeholder issues.
Stronger follow-through on commitments to public institutions and external stakeholders.
Improved ESG evidence quality and assurance readiness.
Closer linkage between public affairs, sustainability and operating execution.
background_relevance: Director-level responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG, social responsibility, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive coordination within a multinational mining operation.

Senior engagement across institutions responsible for mining, environment, energy, labour, aviation, standards, taxation, trade and investment, with documented follow-through across operating functions.

Stakeholder-governance exposure around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, plus a carbon-data pilot built from a 52.6 million-litre fuel baseline, 34 entities, 408 monthly entries and 592 equipment IDs.
Experience aligning Environment, HSE, Legal, Finance, Operations, Procurement, HR, Security, Aviation and technical teams around external commitments, evidence and executive decisions.
